rv.q: The cast and crew of Wicked delivered a show that we all desperately needed.
For a show that has been running for 30 years, I found it has aged well.
This production delivers a thoroughly enjoyable night of theatre.
"Wicked," which just opened at the venerable, 2400 seat Kansas City Music Hall with a recently refreshed cast, is an entertaining example.
This is a finely honed, expertly crafted machine of a show, and every song, every design element, every performance, is perfection.
WICKED is just one of those shows that makes you fall in love with live theater all over again.

Visually, the production is stunning. Wicked has always been a feast for the eyes, and this tour fully delivers. The show holds up beautifully 21 years after its Broadway premiere and eight months before the first half of an all-star major motion picture version gets released.
Not a moment of this Joe Mantello-directed 'Wicked' feels rote or phoned-in.

The stage production of Wicked is spellbinding.
Myagoitia fully embodied Elphaba from the beginning. Her powerful vocals and the way she was able to show the growth Elphaba experienced were masterful.
Wicked is a splendid evening of theatre.
The musical from Broadway whiz Stephen Schwartz is bold and bewitching.
The touring production currently playing at the Music Hall in Kansas City demonstrated that Elphaba (Aline Mayagoitia) and Glinda (Claudia Bennet) can still cast a spell.

cn.t: Critics praise Wicked's electric atmosphere and spectacular staging, with audiences responding enthusiastically to the beloved musical's return. The show delivers the magic and spectacle fans have been eagerly waiting for.
